title: Plan a week of meals and a grocery list
steps: Tell the assistant who you're cooking for, any allergies, and your budget. Ask for 5 dinners and one combined grocery list grouped by store aisle.
watch_out: Double-check allergy and nutrition claims; the assistant can be wrong.

title: Understand a confusing letter or bill
steps: Remove account numbers and personal details, paste the text, and ask: 'Explain this in plain English and list what I need to do and by when.'
watch_out: Not legal, tax or medical advice. Confirm deadlines with the sender.

title: Turn your notes into a study guide
steps: Upload your own notes or slides and ask for a summary, key terms and 10 practice questions.
watch_out: Check answers against your course material; follow your school's AI policy.

title: Turn a meeting into an action list
steps: Let the note-taker join or record the call, then ask its summary for decisions, owners and due dates.
watch_out: Tell attendees you're recording and follow consent rules. Review the summary before sharing.

title: Draft a lesson plan and differentiated worksheets
steps: Give the grade, standard and time available; ask for a lesson outline plus easier and harder versions of the worksheet.
watch_out: Leave student names and records out unless your district has approved the tool.

title: Write a clear reply to a support ticket
steps: Describe the issue in general terms (no passwords, hostnames or user data) and ask for a friendly, step-by-step reply for a non-technical user.
watch_out: Verify every technical step yourself before sending.

title: Automate a follow-up when a new lead comes in
steps: Set a trigger (new form submission), then an action that adds the lead to your CRM and drafts a follow-up email for you to approve.
watch_out: Keep a human approval step before anything is sent to customers. This is a simple 'agent' workflow.

title: Repurpose one article into social posts
steps: Paste your own article and ask for 5 short posts in your brand voice, then lay out graphics in a design tool.
watch_out: Fact-check anything the AI adds that wasn't in your original.

title: Draft a patient-friendly appointment letter template
steps: Ask for a plain-language template with placeholders like [Patient name] and [Date], at a 6th-grade reading level.
watch_out: Never paste real patient information (PHI) into a tool your organization hasn't approved under HIPAA.

title: Clean up a recorded interview
steps: Import the recording, edit the transcript to cut filler and mistakes, and export the trimmed audio or video.
watch_out: Only generate or clone voices with the speaker's permission.

title: Let an assistant protect focus time on your calendar
steps: Connect your calendar, set your working hours and priorities, and let the tool schedule tasks and focus blocks around meetings.
watch_out: Check what calendar access your employer allows before connecting a work account.
